verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents syncing data and accounting information with QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite, and its AI fills accounting fields on bills that users can review, adjust, or override. Nothing in the evidence shows user-controlled GL account, class, or department mappings, so only the sync half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented GL account/class/department mapping configuration, details on what transaction data syncs and how, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control

citations.quote: Sync all data and accounting information with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and more
watch AI fill out accounting fields before routing it for approval
the ability to review, adjust, or override them
